question: Why is the supreme conduct beyond the range even of Brahma and other gods?
premises: The subject is characterized as secret beyond secret.
Brahma and other gods are named as a reference group.
The subject lies outside their range.
inference: The supreme conduct is so profoundly secret that it is inaccessible even to Brahma and other deities.
uncertainties: The repeated guhya element may be emphatic or textual
plain_english: It is secret, more secret than secret, and beyond the range of Brahma and the other gods.
